in_hebrew.name: אלכסנדר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלכסנדר הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'הגנן האלוהי' או 'אלוהים מגן ומסיע'. השם מורכב משתי מילים יווניות: 'אלקסיס' (αλέξω) שפירושה 'להגן' ו'אנדר' (ἀνδρός) שפירושה 'גבר' או 'אדם'. השם אלכסנדר היה נפוץ בקרב היהודים והנוצרים בימי קדם, והוא נמצא גם בברית החדשה.

in_greek.name: Αλέξανδρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Αλέξανδρος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο προστάτης' ή 'προστατεύω'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο ελληνικές λέξεις: 'αλέξω' που σημαίνει 'να προστατεύω' και 'ἀνδρός' που σημαίνει 'άντρας' ή 'άνθρωπος'. Ο Αλέξανδρος ήταν ένα κοινό όνομα μεταξύ των Ελλήνων και των Χριστιανών στην αρχαιότητα.

in_latin.name: Alexander
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alexander originem habet ex lingua Graeca et significat 'Defensor Dei' vel 'Protector'. Nomen est compositum ex duabus vocibus Graecis: 'αλέξω' quod significat 'protegere' et 'ἀνδρός' quod significat 'vir' seu 'homo'. Alexander fuit nomen commune inter Iudaeos et Christianos antiquos.

in_english.name: Aleksandr
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aleksandr is of Greek origin, derived from the words 'alexein' meaning 'to defend' and 'andros' meaning 'man'. It signifies a strong protector or defender. Historically, the name has been associated with Saint Alexander, a 3rd-century bishop of Jerusalem. Aleksandr has been a popular name across various Christian cultures, symbolizing courage and protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aleksandr has been used in various Christian cultures throughout history. In the Eastern Orthodox Church, Saint Aleksandr Nevsky is celebrated as a heroic military leader and is the patron saint of Russia. In the Roman Catholic Church, Saint Aleksandr of Canterbury is the patron saint of Malta and is known for his preaching efforts in the British Isles. The name Aleksandr has also been popular in other Christian communities, including the Greek Orthodox Church and the Coptic Orthodox Church.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aleksandr carries deep spiritual significance, derived from the Greek word 'alexein', which means 'to defend'. In Christian tradition, the name is a reminder of the role of protectors and defenders in the faith. Saints Aleksandr Nevsky and Aleksandr of Canterbury are both remembered for their bravery and their dedication to defending the people of their communities against various threats. The name also emphasizes the importance of standing up for one's beliefs and values in the face of adversity. Ultimately, the name Aleksandr serves as a powerful reminder of the call to be defenders of the faith and protectors of those in need.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aleksandr in Christianity represents the devotion to Saint Alexander, an early Christian martyr, who is known for his unwavering faith and courage in the face of persecution. His name signifies strength, determination, and a steadfast commitment to the teachings of Christ.

historical_references.reference: Born in Russia in 1817, Aleksandr Pushkin is considered the founder of the modern Russian literature.
Aleksandr Nevsky was a Russian prince who ruled Novgorod from 1221 to 1263 and is best known for his military victories against the Swedes and the Teutonic Knights.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
